name: Number.Round
sql_candidate: round_even(x, digits) for default ToEven; CASE/rules for other modes
domain: Known numeric representation; default digits normalized to 0
semantic_risks: DuckDB round breaks ties differently. Decimal/binary precision, negative digits, nulls and every RoundingMode need tests.

name: Table.AddIndexColumn
domain: A represented input order; stable unique keys or an equivalent explicit ordering
semantic_risks: An arbitrary SQL row order cannot reproduce a position-based M index. Preserve output order, numeric type, null/default options.

name: Text.EndsWith
domain: Default case-sensitive comparison; null and empty suffix fixtures required
semantic_risks: Comparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase/culture/custom comparers need separate semantics. Baseline d41d670 documents an ODBC escape barrier; concurrent working-tree experiments are not validated here.

name: Text.Length
sql_candidate: length(t) only in a proven BMP domain; UTF-16-unit adapter otherwise
domain: Well-formed BMP text without surrogate pairs for the direct form
semantic_risks: SDK Text.Length("a😀b")=4; DuckDB length=3. Full Unicode parity is not established.

name: Text.Middle
sql_candidate: substr(t, start + 1, count); two-argument form when count omitted
domain: Nonnegative integral offsets/counts; verified character representation
semantic_risks: Zero-based versus one-based positions; UTF-16 versus code points; negative/fractional bounds; null/omitted arguments.

name: Text.PadEnd
sql_candidate: CASE WHEN m_length(t) >= n THEN t ELSE rpad(t,n,pad) END
domain: Integral nonnegative n; explicit validated one-character pad
semantic_risks: DuckDB rpad truncates long inputs. Unicode units and optional pad semantics require coverage.

name: Text.PadStart
sql_candidate: CASE WHEN m_length(t) >= n THEN t ELSE lpad(t,n,pad) END
domain: Integral nonnegative n; explicit validated one-character pad
semantic_risks: DuckDB lpad truncates long inputs. M length and pad character units may differ; default/null pad must be normalized.

name: Text.PositionOf
domain: First occurrence; default ordinal comparer; compatible character positions
semantic_risks: Occurrence.Last/All return different results/shapes. Supplementary Unicode changes offsets; culture/custom comparers need separate rules.

name: Text.Range
sql_candidate: CASE WHEN invalid_bounds THEN error(...) ELSE substr(t, offset + 1, count) END
domain: Explicit integral bounds and a compatible character representation
semantic_risks: Unlike Text.Middle, an excessive count raises an M error. SQL error is query-level, not automatically an M cell error.

name: Text.Trim
domain: Explicit validated character set
semantic_risks: Default whitespace sets differ: SDK trims tab/newline in the probe; DuckDB default trim does not. M also accepts trim-character lists.

name: Text.TrimEnd
domain: Explicit validated character set
semantic_risks: Default whitespace sets differ: SDK trims tab/newline in the probe; DuckDB default trim does not. M also accepts trim-character lists.

name: Text.TrimStart
domain: Explicit validated character set
semantic_risks: Default whitespace sets differ: SDK trims tab/newline in the probe; DuckDB default trim does not. M also accepts trim-character lists.

name: Value.Equals
sql_candidate: a IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b
domain: Comparable primitive values with validated type mapping
semantic_risks: M null equality differs from SQL =. Structural values, mixed types, numeric precision, NaN and errors need further rules.

name: Value.NullableEquals
domain: Comparable primitive values with validated type mapping
semantic_risks: This function returns null when either argument is null; do not reuse Value.Equals null-safe translation.

name: Date.AddDays
domain: Integral n; validated date range
semantic_risks: DateTime and DateTimeZone preserve a different type/time component; fractional n, overflow and nulls need policy.

name: Date.AddMonths
sql_candidate: CAST(d + n * INTERVAL '1 month' AS DATE) for date inputs
domain: Integral n and DATE input
semantic_risks: Month-end clipping, leap days, return-kind preservation and datetimezone variants.

name: Date.Day
domain: M date or validated datetime conversion
semantic_risks: Return M number; null/type/range and timezone date extraction.

name: Date.DayOfWeek
domain: Explicit firstDayOfWeek in the M Day enumeration
semantic_risks: Omitted firstDayOfWeek is culture dependent. Do not silently use DuckDB Sunday or ISO Monday defaults.

name: Date.EndOfMonth
domain: Date-only input
semantic_risks: Datetime/datetimezone end-of-day fractional precision differs; last_day alone is not general M parity.

name: Date.Month
domain: M date or validated datetime conversion
semantic_risks: Return M number; null/type/range and timezone date extraction.

name: Date.StartOfMonth
sql_candidate: date_trunc('month', d) with result type restoration
domain: Explicit date/datetime/datetimezone input contract
semantic_risks: Preserve M return kind and timezone representation.

name: Date.Year
domain: M date or validated datetime conversion
semantic_risks: Return M number; null/type/range and timezone date extraction.

name: List.Average
domain: Known numeric list/column context
semantic_risks: Empty/all-null input, numeric precision, temporal values and errors.

name: List.Count
sql_candidate: count(*) for a column-derived list; len(xs) for a list value
domain: Known list representation
semantic_risks: Includes null elements; count(column) would silently change the answer.

name: List.Max
sql_candidate: max(column) or list_max(xs) only in a verified null policy
domain: Known comparable primitive values
semantic_risks: includeNulls/default/comparisonCriteria can invalidate the direct SQL aggregate.

name: List.Min
sql_candidate: min(column) or list_min(xs) only in a verified null policy
domain: Known comparable primitive values
semantic_risks: includeNulls/default/comparisonCriteria can invalidate the direct SQL aggregate.

name: List.NonNullCount
sql_candidate: count(column); len(list_filter(xs, lambda x: x IS NOT NULL))
domain: Known list/column representation
semantic_risks: Distinguish a null list from a list containing nulls; error elements need handling.

name: List.Sum
sql_candidate: sum(column) for a table column; list_sum(xs) for a list value
domain: Known numeric list/column context
semantic_risks: Empty/all-null input, Precision parameter, errors and decimal/binary representation.

name: Number.Abs
domain: Validated number representation
semantic_risks: Minimum integer overflow, null, NaN/infinity and decimal/binary behavior.

name: Number.IntegerDivide
sql_candidate: trunc(a / b) with explicit precision handling
domain: Validated finite numeric domain and nonzero divisor
semantic_risks: Integer versus floating division, requested Precision, negative operands, zero divisor and overflow.

name: Number.Mod
sql_candidate: a - b * trunc(a / b) after precision/domain validation
domain: Validated finite numeric domain and nonzero divisor
semantic_risks: Do not assume % has M semantics for all numeric types; sign, precision, zero divisor and NaN require probes.

name: Number.Power
domain: Validated real-number domain
semantic_risks: Negative base/noninteger exponent, overflow, NaN, infinity and error behavior.

name: Number.RoundDown
domain: Validated finite x and a numerically safe scale
semantic_risks: Optional digits require scaling; binary rounding, overflow/underflow and result types must match.

name: Number.RoundTowardZero
domain: Validated finite x and a numerically safe scale
semantic_risks: Optional digits and result type; do not confuse with Floor/RoundDown for negatives.

name: Number.RoundUp
domain: Validated finite x and a numerically safe scale
semantic_risks: Optional digits require scaling; negative values, overflow and null behavior.

name: Table.AddColumn
sql_candidate: SELECT ..., translated_expression AS new_column FROM q
domain: Lambda entirely inside a supported expression subset
semantic_risks: Declared M type, errors, closure constants and unsupported lambda calls.

name: Table.Combine
sql_candidate: UNION ALL with schema alignment and typed NULLs
domain: Compatible foldable tables; known output schema
semantic_risks: Column union/order, missing fields, optional column type specification and source privacy.

name: Table.Distinct
domain: Full-row distinct or an explicitly validated key selection strategy
semantic_risks: equationCriteria/comparers, which duplicate survives, nested values and null semantics.

name: Table.ExpandTableColumn
sql_candidate: Flatten a compatible nested-join plan via JOIN/projection
domain: Nested table came from a recognized foldable plan
semantic_risks: Empty nested tables, duplicate matches, names, nesting and cardinality.

name: Table.FirstN
domain: Numeric count overload and represented input order
semantic_risks: Predicate overload requires a prefix algorithm; n validation and sort/tie behavior.

name: Table.Group
sql_candidate: GROUP BY keys with individually translated aggregates
domain: Supported aggregate lambdas and grouping comparers
semantic_risks: GroupKind.Local depends on contiguous groups and cannot be replaced blindly by global GROUP BY; grouped nested tables need separate representation.

name: Table.Join
sql_candidate: JOIN with per-key null-safe conditions where required
domain: Supported JoinKind and compatible key types
semantic_risks: M versus SQL null equality, comparers, duplicate fan-out, column collisions, JoinAlgorithm hints and row order.

name: Table.NestedJoin
sql_candidate: JOIN plan retaining a nested-match representation
domain: Known join keys and a defined representation for nested tables
semantic_risks: Flattening early changes the nested table value and later expansion/aggregation behavior.

name: Table.RemoveColumns
domain: Known constant column list and schema
semantic_risks: MissingField modes and exact column order; avoid unreviewed SELECT * schema drift.

name: Table.RenameColumns
sql_candidate: SELECT old_column AS new_column, ... FROM q
domain: Known rename operations and schema
semantic_risks: Collision rules, missing fields, chained/swapped renames and identifier escaping.

name: Table.RowCount
domain: A foldable table expression
semantic_risks: 64-bit count mapping and scalar result type; preserve filtering and join multiplicity.

name: Table.SelectColumns
domain: Known constant column list and schema
semantic_risks: MissingField modes, column order, duplicate names and safe identifier quoting.

name: Table.SelectRows
domain: Only predicates whose full expression tree has valid SQL lowering
semantic_risks: Arbitrary M lambdas, nullable predicates, error evaluation and privacy/source boundaries.

name: Table.Skip
domain: Numeric count overload and represented input order
semantic_risks: Predicate overload requires a prefix algorithm; n validation and sort/tie behavior.

name: Table.Sort
domain: Supported criteria/comparers and retained ordering state
semantic_risks: Null order, collations, ties and later order-sensitive operations.

name: Table.TransformColumnTypes
sql_candidate: CAST(expression AS mapped_type) plus culture-aware adapters
domain: Supported source/destination types and explicit conversion semantics
semantic_risks: Culture, decimal precision, overflow, datetimezone offset loss and M per-cell errors.

name: Table.TransformColumns
domain: Known transform operations and schema
semantic_risks: Default transformation, MissingField, declared types and arbitrary lambdas.

name: Text.Combine
sql_candidate: concat_ws(separator, item1, item2, ...) for a static list; ordered string_agg for rows
domain: Known text items; M default separator normalized to empty string
semantic_risks: Skip null items, preserve list order, handle empty/all-null input and distinguish a list within a row from a column aggregation.

name: Text.Contains
domain: Default ordinal comparer; null fixtures required
semantic_risks: Native SQL treats needle literally. Current connector emits LIKE and must escape %, _ and the escape character. Comparers need separate handling.

name: Text.End
domain: Nonnegative integer n and compatible text character units
semantic_risks: M UTF-16 units versus DuckDB code points; negative/fractional n and null behavior.

name: Text.Lower
domain: A specifically verified culture/character domain
semantic_risks: Optional culture and Turkish dotted/dotless I; lower/ILIKE is not a general implementation of an M comparer.

name: Text.Replace
domain: Default literal replacement; validated argument types
semantic_risks: Empty search text and null/error behavior require reference cases.

name: Text.Split
domain: Literal nonempty separator with validated text representation
semantic_risks: Empty separator, empty tokens, Unicode and null/error cases need explicit reference results.

name: Text.Start
domain: Nonnegative integer n and compatible text character units
semantic_risks: M UTF-16 units versus DuckDB code points; negative/fractional n and null behavior.

name: Text.StartsWith
domain: Default ordinal comparer; null/empty-prefix fixtures required
semantic_risks: Current connector emits LIKE; wildcard escaping and comparer restrictions remain necessary.

name: Text.Upper
domain: A specifically verified culture/character domain
semantic_risks: Optional culture and Unicode case mapping may differ.

name: List.Contains
sql_candidate: list_contains(xs, value) plus M-compatible null/comparer rules
domain: Validated primitive list type and equality
semantic_risks: DuckDB and M null membership and comparer semantics need adapters; mixed-type lists require a representation.

name: List.Select
domain: Known homogeneous list and supported predicate
semantic_risks: Nullable/error predicates and arbitrary M closures.

name: List.Transform
domain: Known homogeneous list type and supported lambda expression
semantic_risks: Closures, mixed values, row errors, M versus DuckDB index conventions and dynamic functions.

name: Table.FillDown
sql_candidate: last_value(col IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY stable_keys ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
domain: Represented stable input order
semantic_risks: Preserve leading nulls, column types and exact prior row order; cannot invent an order.

name: Table.Pivot
sql_candidate: Conditional aggregates or PIVOT with explicit columns
domain: Static pivot values and supported aggregate
semantic_risks: Dynamic output schema, duplicate key errors, aggregator semantics and naming.

name: Table.Unpivot
sql_candidate: UNPIVOT or UNION ALL with explicit column alignment
domain: Known source columns and compatible value representation
semantic_risks: Null omission, mixed M value types and output row/column order.
